findings.one_line: The 16-term recursive ledger drops the normal-equation terms d_{p,ell}^T r_beta and d_{q,ell}^T r_a, where r_beta=(I-P_Y)\bar y and r_a=(I-P_Z)\bar z_rec; neither ass:unit-recovery nor ass:recursive-recovery sets these response projection residuals to zero (unlike direct-response-span), so (25) is not the stated exact remainder and its uniform bound must be redone or the missing span assumptions added.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim CCK (2015) Theorem 2 gives the stated worst-case Delta^(1/3)[1 vee log(p/Delta)]^(2/3) comparison bound, and Theorem 3(i) plus Comment 5 gives anti-concentration for the maximum of signed coordinates. With p=2H_n and unit marginal variances the constants are universal; neither result requires covariance nonsingularity.
